description:
Midtown Umbrellas is a premium outdoor brand specializing in high-quality, commercial-grade patio umbrellas designed for both residential and professional spaces. Our collection includes market umbrellas, cantilever umbrellas, and innovative designs like the Push & Pop system, all built with durability, performance, and aesthetics in mind. We use top-tier materials such as Sunbrella and our proprietary Terylast fabrics, ensuring long-lasting color, weather resistance, and a luxury finish. Our products are trusted by homeowners, designers, hotels, and restaurants across North America.

What Makes Us Different
Midtown Umbrellas stands apart because we are not a reseller, we are the brand, meaning customers buy directly from the source with no middleman markup. We combine premium design with fast logistics, offering next-day shipping across the U.S., which is rare in this category. Our umbrellas are commercial-grade, built to last, and designed with unique styles and exclusive features, all supported by a strong focus on customer experience, hands-on service, and continuous innovation.

How Affiliates Can Earn
Affiliates can earn a 10% commission on every sale generated through their unique referral link, with commissions validated and paid 30 days after the customer’s purchase to ensure all orders are finalized. There is no cap on earnings, creating a strong opportunity to generate scalable revenue.

How to Promote Us
Affiliates have full flexibility in how they promote Midtown Umbrellas, including through social media platforms like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, and Twitter, by creating high-quality videos or user-generated content, writing blog articles or product reviews, sharing links on websites or third-party platforms, and ordering samples to produce authentic content in real outdoor settings.

Other Information
Upon approval, affiliates receive a custom tracking link and commissions are tracked automatically through the platform. Self-purchases or fraudulent activity are not permitted, and products cannot be resold on other marketplaces or platforms. Our team remains available to support affiliates with guidance, product information, and content direction to help maximize performance and success.
payout_period: Payouts are paid on the 1st of the month. We only pay out the commission after the customer keeps the product for 30 days.
